notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 24 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting shniz(8)': Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Alderaan, Prepared Defenses, Crush The Rebellion, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, A Million Voices Crying Out; they count toward the 60. Three Effects start and the post names none as the starting Effect, so no starting Effect is set. Total 60.
The 'Epic Events1' section header was mis-parsed as a card and removed; Commence Primary Ignition is the one Epic Event.

Posted 'SYC/Game Over' dested Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe; 'DSDB' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Alderaan', 'Yavin 4', 'Hoth' and 'Sullust' dested the Dark system cards.

Posted 'Georgia Thrawn' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn; '4-LOM w/ Crifle' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Vader w/ Saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Emperor Palpy' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'DS Gunner' dested Death Star Gunner.
Posted 'Big E (original)' dested Executor; 'Dengar in boat' dested Dengar In Punishing One; 'Zuckuss In MH' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Vengence' dested Vengeance.
Posted 'Evader/Monok' dested Evader & Monnok; 'Twilek' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'The Circus is now Complete' dested The Circle Is Now Complete; 'CPI' dested Commence Primary Ignition.
Posted 'CHYBC' dested Come Here You Big Coward and 'SSPFT' dested Something Special Planned For Them; Come Here You Big Coward and Secret Plans were Effects in 2001, not Defensive Shields.
The strategy says the deck went 10-1 in post-Tatooine tournament play; no event is named, so it stays a general deck.
